setting.string: Show set contents on customer documents
setting.help: Allow rental orders to print the contents of a rental set on the quotation, order confirmation, portal and invoice — indented under the set line and without prices. Off by default: only the set line is shown, carrying the whole price. Each order then decides for itself ('Show Set Contents').

setting.string: Show stock & locations in availability pop-up
setting.help: Show the 'Physical stock (right now)' section — total stock and its locations — in the rental availability pop-up. Off by default; handy for troubleshooting.

setting.string: Warn about stock on option by other orders
setting.help: Show 'on option by other orders' in the availability pop-up and turn the availability icon red when unconfirmed quotations (on option until their validity date) could make a line unfulfillable. Informational only.
